WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT s.School,
           s.GSserved,
           substr(s.GSserved, 1, instr(s.GSserved || '-', '-') - 1) AS first_grade
    FROM schools AS s
    WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
      AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
      AND s.School IS NOT NULL
      AND (s.GSserved = '12' OR s.GSserved LIKE '%-12')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM satscores AS t
          WHERE t.cds = s.CDSCode
            AND t.NumTstTakr > 0
      )
), graded AS (
    SELECT School,
           GSserved,
           CASE first_grade
               WHEN 'P' THEN -1
               WHEN 'K' THEN 0
               ELSE CAST(first_grade AS INTEGER)
           END AS grade_order
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT School, GSserved
FROM graded
WHERE grade_order = (SELECT MIN(grade_order) FROM graded)
ORDER BY School COLLATE NOCASE;

WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT County, District, School, CDSCode, AdmFName1, AdmFName2, AdmFName3
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND DOCType IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
),
districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT County, District
    FROM scoped
),
school_rows AS (
    SELECT * FROM scoped WHERE School IS NOT NULL
),
school_names AS (
    SELECT County, District, CDSCode, AdmFName1 AS first_name FROM school_rows
    UNION
    SELECT County, District, CDSCode, AdmFName2 FROM school_rows
    UNION
    SELECT County, District, CDSCode, AdmFName3 FROM school_rows
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS total_schools
    FROM school_names
    WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL AND first_name <> ''
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY total_schools DESC, first_name ASC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT d.District AS district_name, t.first_name, COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS school_count
FROM districts AS d

    FROM account AS a

    FROM borrowers AS b
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t

    GROUP BY b.account_id

JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district AS home ON home.district_id = c.district_id
ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, b.account_id ASC;

WITH qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000
),
qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cl.gender, d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name,
           CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
           d.A11 AS salary, d.A10 AS urban_ratio
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS holder ON holder.disp_id = c.disp_id AND holder.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = holder.client_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = holder.account_id
    JOIN qualifying_accounts AS q ON q.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
      AND cl.gender IN ('F', 'M')
      AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) > 100000
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT *,
           COUNT(*) OVER by_gender AS district_count,
           MAX(inhabitants) OVER by_gender AS max_inhabitants,
           ROUND(AVG(salary) OVER by_gender, 2) AS avg_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio) OVER by_gender, 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
    FROM qualifying_districts
    WINDOW by_gender AS (PARTITION BY gender)
)
SELECT gender, district_count, district_name, inhabitants, avg_salary, avg_urban_ratio
FROM district_stats
WHERE inhabitants = max_inhabitants
ORDER BY gender, district_name, district_id;

FROM bounds AS b
